lot.description: bid.cars lot id `{source}-{number}` as returned by `search_lots`. Pattern: ^[0-9]-[0-9]{1,12}$.

url.description: A bid.cars lot page URL. Pattern: ^https?://(www\.)?bid\.cars/[a-z]{2}/lot/[0-9]-[0-9]{1,12}(/.*)?$.

vin.description: Vehicle identification number; resolved to the lot through the site's VIN lookup. Pattern: ^[A-HJ-NPR-Za-hj-npr-z0-9]{11,17}$.

200.description:
One bid.cars lot from its server-rendered detail page `GET /en/lot/{lot}/{tag}`, addressed by lot id (`0-46008811`, `1-51374586`), by VIN (resolved through the site's `/app/search/en/vin-lot/{vin}/false` lookup) or by a pasted lot URL. Returns the Vehicle JSON-LD identity (year, make, model, VIN, colour, transmission, damages, sale date), the header (title, location, shipping terminal, seller, sale document, estimated value range), the bidding box (current bid and time left for active lots; `archived: true` with `auction_ended_on` and a hidden final bid for sold lots: the site masks final bids for anonymous users), the vehicle information block (loss, damages, odometer, start code, key, ACV/ERC, body, colour, engine, transmission, fuel, drive), the auction-house details list, the sales-history table and the image gallery. A lot the site does not know answers HTTP 410 and is `not_found`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `archived` | boolean | The auction has ended and the page is the site's archived view. |

| `final_bid_hidden` | boolean | True when the site shows `Hidden` / masked instead of a final bid (anonymous view of a sold lot). |
| `final_bid_usd` | number | Archived lots: final bid when the site shows it; null while hidden. |
| `image` | string |  |
| `images` | string[] | Gallery thumbnails in the site's order. |
| `images_large` | string[] |  |
| `known_damages` | string |  |
| `live_auction_at` | string | Active lots: live auction date/time text, e.g. `Monday, 12 October, 15:30`. |

post.description:
Browse or filter lots currently at auction; find the lot id or VIN for `get_lot` and `similar_sold_lots`.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

auction_type.description:
Source auction house (default All).

Provider reference: allowed values ["All", "Copart", "IAAI"].

body_style.description: Site body-style filter value (Sedan, SUV, Pickup, Hatchback, Coupe, Minivan, Crossover, Convertible, Cargo-Van, Van, Wagon).

continuation.description: Continuation from a previous call (`next_cursor`): the next page number. Overrides `page`. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,4}$.

estimated_max.description:
Upper bound of the site's estimated value (USD).

Provider reference: minimum 0.

estimated_min.description:
Lower bound of the site's estimated value (USD).

Provider reference: minimum 0.

fuel_type.description: Site fuel-type filter value (Diesel, Electric, Hybrid).

limit.description:
Return at most this many lots from the page (the site always serves 50 per page; the rest of the page is dropped). Pagination is unaffected.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 50.

loss_type.description: Site loss-type filter value (Biohazard, Fire, Hail, Mechanical, Repossession, Theft, Vandalized, Water).

model.description: Model as listed by `makes_models` (e.g. `3 Series`); default `All`. Requires `make`.

order_by.description:
Site sort key (filter mode); omitted means the site's default order (sale date).

Provider reference: allowed values ["date", "dateDesc", "estimated", "estimatedDesc", "prebid", "prebidDesc", "buynow", "buynowDesc", "year", "yearDesc", "odometer", "odometerDesc"].

page.description:
1-based page of 50 lots (default 1).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 1000.

query.description: Free-text search (`search-type=typing`): make/model words, a VIN or a lot number. Mutually exclusive with the structured filters.

status.description:
Site status filter: All (default), Active (pre-bid open), Live (auction in progress), Ended (finished today), Fast-buy (Buy Now lots).

Provider reference: allowed values ["All", "Active", "Live", "Ended", "Fast-buy"].

vehicle_type.description: Site vehicle type for filter mode, as the site spells it: Automobile (default), Motorcycle, Atv, Personal-watercraft, Snowmobile, Truck, Boat, ...

year_from.description:
Model year lower bound (default 1900).

Provider reference: minimum 1900; maximum 2100.

year_to.description:
Model year upper bound (default 2027).

Provider reference: minimum 1900; maximum 2100.

200.description:
One page (50 lots) of bid.cars active-auction search over `GET /app/search/request`. Two modes: free text (`query`, the site's `search-type=typing`: VIN, lot number, make/model words) or structured filters (`search-type=filters`: vehicle type, make, model, year range, auction house, status, loss type, fuel type, body style, estimated value range) with the site's `order_by` sort. Every record carries the lot id (`{source}-{number}`: 0 = IAAI stock number, 1 = Copart lot), VIN, canonical URL, current pre-bid, Buy Now price, bid-closing time, estimated value range, odometer, damage, start code, sale document and images, as the site states them (USD, miles). Follow `next_page` / the continuation to paginate; a page past the end is a legitimate empty page. Sold/archived lots are account-gated on the site and are not returned here.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `country` | string |  |
| `currency` | string |  |
| `filters` | object | The filter values actually sent (filter mode only), with the site's defaults filled in. |
| `from` | number | 1-based index of the first lot on this page as the site reports it; null on an empty page. |
| `lots` | object[] |  |
| `mode` | string |  |
| `next_page` | number | Next page number when the site reports one, else null (last page). |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `page` | number |  |
| `per_page` | number |  |
| `query` | string |  |
| `result_count` | number | Lots returned (the page's 50, or fewer after `limit` or on the last page). |
| `to` | number |  |

200.description:
Sold comparables the site shows under a lot: recently sold lots of the same make/model with their public final prices, sale dates, sellers and thumbnails, from `GET /app/lot/{lot}/similar` (active lots) with a fallback to `GET /app/lot/{lot}/archived/similar` (the variant the archived lot page loads; `archived` tells which one answered). This is the only anonymous source of final prices on bid.cars (the archived search and archived lot pages mask them). An unknown lot id is `not_found`; a known lot with no comparables is an empty list.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `archived` | boolean | False when the active-lot feed answered, true when the archived-lot feed did, null when both were empty. |
| `comparables` | object[] |  |
| `count` | number |  |
| `country` | string |  |
| `currency` | string |  |
| `lot` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
